authority: UDCPR 2020 (Maharashtra) — illustrative reference. VERIFY every figure against your target authority's sanctioned DCR before treating any result as binding.
notes: Structured after real development control: setbacks are looked up (by road width) and computed (by height band), not flat constants. Figures follow published UDCPR/Nagpur tables but are a reference model, not a substitute for the sanctioned DCR.

front_setback.rule: greater of the road-width band and the height override

side_rear_setback.rule: by building-height band — a formula, not a constant

max_height.rule: capped by abutting road width; > 24 m is high-rise (needs CFO NOC)

fsi.rule: FSI is a stack: basic + premium (chargeable). Achieved = total built-up ÷ plot.
fsi.note: Premium is chargeable and jurisdiction-dependent; TDR loading and free-of-FSI ancillary (~up to 60%) are excluded here for clarity.

ground_coverage_pct.clause: UDCPR — governed indirectly via marginal distances
ground_coverage_pct.note: UDCPR controls coverage through the setbacks above, not a single %. This flat cap is an advisory sanity check only.

parking.clause: UDCPR 6.9 (ECS by carpet-area band per tenement)
parking.rule: ECS per tenement scales with its carpet area; visitor parking is additional

room_standards.note: Habitable = bedroom/living/dining. Ventilation needs an openable area ≥ 1/8 of floor area — checked against a window schedule, which a plan alone rarely carries.
